lead.headline: Justice Department's Epstein file list for Data Set 10 shrank from 10,071 to 5,569 pages, March to late May 2026
lead.number: Data Set 10: 10,071 to 5,569 pages (about 225,000 file links out of the listing) by Mar 8; Data Set 9: 10,675 to 770 for about 4 weeks; both back May 22-23.
lead.watch_out: Both "joins" are one Wayback crawl read twice, and the pager is flaky (Data Set 9 showed no pager for 16 days, Data Set 10 read 102 on Feb 1); a missing tail fits a search index refilling in file-number order.
